claim_type.caption: Claim Type
claim_type.description: The kind of credential claim the authority evaluated, normalized to the caption of claim_type_id. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

claim_type_id.caption: Claim Type ID
claim_type_id.description: The normalized kind of credential claim the authority evaluated.

claim_decision.caption: Decision
claim_decision.description: The authority's verdict on the evaluated claim, normalized to the caption of claim_decision_id. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

claim_decision_id.caption: Decision ID
claim_decision_id.description: The normalized verdict of the authority on the evaluated claim.

reason.caption: Reason
reason.description: The normalized reason the claim was rejected, as the caption of reason_id. Populate when claim_decision_id is 'Rejected'; omit otherwise. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

reason_id.caption: Reason ID
reason_id.description: The normalized reason the authority rejected the claim. Required when claim_decision_id is 'Rejected'; absent otherwise. The rejected reasons must not collapse: e.g. an unregistered key (possible attack) and a bad signature (defect or misconfiguration) triage completely differently. An absent accounting_decision means unknown — never 'no decision was made.'

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The reason the claim was rejected is unknown.

1.caption: Unregistered Key
1.description: The key was never registered — treat as a possible attack.

2.caption: Bad Signature
2.description: The signature failed verification — treat as a defect or misconfiguration.

3.caption: Expired
3.description: The claim or credential had expired.

4.caption: Future Dated
4.description: The claim or credential is dated in the future.

5.caption: Malformed
5.description: The claim or credential could not be parsed.

6.caption: No Keys Registered
6.description: No keys are registered for the claimed identity at all.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The claim was rejected for a reason outside this set. See the reason attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

caption: Accounting Decision
description: The verdict of an authority that evaluated an agent identity or credential claim — e.g. whether a presented key was attested, left unproven, or rejected — and, when rejected, the normalized reason. Carries the decision half of the evidence contract: a decision without a reason cannot be audited, only counted.
name: accounting_decision
